commentary.text: 90+6' Javier Alberola is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' The referee signals a substitution. Jorge Cestero Sancho (Real Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Federico Valverde.
90+1' 0 - 2 Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
88' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jose Copete (Valencia) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

71' A great pass puts Lucas Beltran (Valencia) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
69' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Javier Alberola and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
65' 0 - 1 Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) becomes the centre of attention as he finishes a great individual effort with a nice goal. His low shot ended up inside the left post.
63' Real Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
62' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Stole Dimitrievski.
62' The Real Madrid players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
60' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
58' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
56' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

55' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.

55' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball. Valencia are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
54' The resulting set piece from Real Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
54' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
49' Jose Gaya (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Jose Gaya (Valencia) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
39' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Madrid comes to nothing.

38' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
36' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.
32' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid). Javier Alberola saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick to Valencia.
28' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is adjudged offside.
23' Flag up against Jose Gaya (Valencia). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
21' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

19' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Stole Dimitrievski guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
18' Real Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
18' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Madrid comes to nothing. Real Madrid get a corner.
16' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is penalised for holding. Javier Alberola signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to Valencia.
15' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
15' Jose Gaya (Valencia) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
11' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Real Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Javier Alberola blows for a foul. Valencia have been awarded a free kick.
